# INRAIT

> INRAIT is a digital agency based in Sofia providing web application development, UI/UX design, and workflow automation services.

## About Us
We build scalable web applications, design intuitive user interfaces, and automate business processes to help clients streamline their digital operations.

## Core Services
- **Web Application Development:** Full-stack frontend and backend development utilizing Vue.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Workflow Automation:** Custom business logic and automation pipelines built with n8n, webhooks, and third-party API integrations.
- **UI/UX & Branding:** Interface design, vector graphics, logos, and product mockups.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure:** Secure deployment pipelines using Docker, Dokploy, and Traefik.
